tasks.title: The Human Body in 1,000 Years
paras: Evolution has changed our bodies and faces over thousands of years-and it’s still happening. Here’s how leading anatomical experts predict our descendants will differ physically from us in 1,000 years from now.

We’ll be taller at 6-7ft because of improved nutrition and medical science. Osteopath Garry Trainer says:“The average American is about one inch taller than 1960". Our intestines will get shorter so we don't absorb as much fat and sugar-a natural way of avoiding obesity, says dentist Dr.Philip Stemmer.

We’ll have smaller brains, maybe because so much memorizing and thinking is done by our computers. “Science fiction images show humans of the future with big brains, but big brains are not necessarily the best." says Chris Stringer, from the Natural History Museum. There will be large eyes to compensate for smaller mouths. Gary Cooper, of Lancaster University, explains: “Communication will rely on facial expression and eye movements.”

Dentist Doctor Stemmer also thinks there could be fewer teeth as softer food needs less chewing and biting. He says: "We could even get our nutrition from liquids or pills in the future, which could mean less teeth and receded jaws.”

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the passage?

options.A: What we will look like 1000 years later
options.C: Why our bodies and faces are changing over time
options.D: What our ancestors looked like in the past

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 原文定位：全文围绕未来1000年人类形体变化预测展开： 首段明确点题："how leading experts predict our descendants will differ physically in 1,000 years"（专家预测千年后人类身体变化）； 后续段落逐一列举具体变化（身高、肠道、大脑、牙齿等）。 选项分析： B 仅提到"evolution changed"但未聚焦"未来"； C "原因分析"是细节，非主线； D "祖先外貌"未涉及。

questions.stem: The word "descendant" is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 定位原文：首段"how our descendants will differ physically in 1,000 years"（千年后我们的______将如何不同）。 语义匹配： "descendant" 指"后代、子孙"，与 "offspring"（子女，后代）同义； 选项分析： A predecessor（前任/祖先） C ancestor（祖先）表逆向时间关系； B generation（一代人）未体现血缘传承。

questions.stem: According to the passage, why will people's intestines get shorter?

options.A: Because people's diet will be more balanced.
options.B: Because with shorter intestines people will absorb less fat and sugar.
options.C: Because obesity will be a common disease in the future.
options.D: Because people will be working on losing weight.

questions.analysis: 题型：推断题 原文依据：第二段明确说明： "Our intestines will get shorter so we don't absorb as much fat and sugar—a natural way of avoiding obesity." （肠道变短→减少脂肪/糖吸收→自然避免肥胖） 因果逻辑：缩短肠道是演化适应，直接目的是减少热量吸收。 选项分析： A"饮食均衡"未提及； C 肥胖是当前问题，非未来原因； D "减肥"是结果而非目的。

questions.stem: What does Chris Stringer imply about science fiction images?

options.C: They are correspondent with what he predicts.

questions.analysis: 题型：推断题 原文定位：专家观点，第四段中Chris Stringer反驳科幻设定： "Science fiction images show humans with big brains, but big brains are not necessarily the best." （科幻描绘大脑巨大，但大脑大未必最优） 根据文章 Science fiction images show humans of the future with big brains,but big brains are not necessarily the best, 可知，科幻小说推测人们未来会有更大的脑袋，但这并不是最适合人类生存的，由此推断科幻小说里的描述并不科学，故选 D。

questions.stem: According to Doctor Stemmer, why would there be fewer teeth?

options.A: Because people will eat less food in the future.
options.B: Because people will have smaller mouths.
options.C: Because people's jaws will be receded.
options.D: Because people will eat soft food and too many teeth are unnecessary.

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文定位：直接引用第五段Stemmer的解释： "softer food needs less chewing and biting... We could even get nutrition from liquids or pills, which could mean fewer teeth." （软食减少咀嚼需求→液体/药丸饮食→牙齿退化） 核心逻辑：功能退化（use it or lose it）——不需要的器官在演化中缩减。 选项分析： B "嘴变小"是伴随现象，非原因； C "颌骨后移"是牙齿减少的衍生结果。
